body: Please handle `detect_folders` even if the default is empty.

Please don't run the command by default, version command invocations for java applications are too slow for a prompt for most people. Please add a toggle for this (default disabled) or use a different means to determine the version, or remove it entirely. In addition, please also disable this module by default to avoid confusing users if the module is displayed without the version.

In addition, this will need a test via `ModuleRenderer` using command mocking (it should be explained in `Contributing.md`).

Please use `find_map` instead. I feel like something like this makes more sense:
```rust
e
    .trim_start()
    .strip_prefix("version ")
    .and_then(|e| e.split_ascii_whitespace().first())
    .map(str::to_owned)
```

`.map` also uses an `Option`-value. It would be better to avoid unwrapping it:
```suggestion
    let mut nextflow_version = context.get_env("NXF_VER").filter(|v| v.trim().is_empty());
```
